## Task System Overview - Complete Report

I've thoroughly explored the task system in the thos codebase. Here's the full picture of how tasks work:

### 1. Task Data Model (`lib/types.ts`)

The task system defines these core types:

**Task Interface (lines 385-395):**
```typescript
export interface Task {
  id: string;                    // Unique identifier (4-byte hex, e.g., "5c32beb8")
  title: string;                 // Task name
  description: string;           // Detailed description
  status: TaskStatus;            // "todo" | "in-progress" | "done"
  priority: TaskPriority;        // "low" | "medium" | "high" | "urgent"
  agentId: string | null;        // Linked Claude agent ID (null if not delegated)
  createdAt: number;             // Timestamp when created
  updatedAt: number;             // Timestamp of last update
}
```

**Status & Priority Types:**
- `TaskStatus`: "todo" | "in-progress" | "done"
- `TaskPriority`: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "urgent"

**Browser → Server Messages (lines 172-210):**
- `BrowserCreateTask` — Create new task with title, description, priority
- `BrowserUpdateTask` — Update title, description, status, or priority
- `BrowserDeleteTask` — Remove a task
- `BrowserDelegateTask` — Spawn an agent for the task

**Server → Browser Messages (lines 280-311):**
- `ServerTaskList` — Full task list sent on browser connect (line 281-284)
- `ServerTaskUpdated` — Single task change notification
- `ServerTaskDeleted` — Task deletion confirmation

### 2. TaskCard Component (`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`)

The primary task UI component with full editing and state management:

**Key Features:**
- **Expandable cards** — Click to expand and see full description
- **Inline editing** — Double-click title to edit, or use edit button
- **Priority selector** — Visual colored badges (urgent=red, high=orange, medium=yellow, low=gray)
- **Status cycling** — Click status badge to cycle: todo → in-progress → done → todo
- **Metadata display** — Shows creation time (relative "2m ago"), update time, and task ID
- **Actions:**
  - Edit button (pencil icon) — opens edit mode for title, description, priority
  - Delete button (trash icon) — permanently remove task
  - Delegate button (play icon) — spawn Claude agent for task (only shows if not delegated and not done)
  - View agent link — "view agent" button appears when task has `agentId` set

**Color System:**
- Priority colors match severity (red for urgent through neutral gray for low)
- Status colors indicate workflow state (blue for in-progress, green for done, default for todo)

**Sample Data from `.thos/tasks/tasks.json`:**
The file contains 23 tasks with varying statuses and priorities. Examples:
- Task "Message timestamps" (5c32beb8) — status: done, priority: high, linked to agent 7ce5bafa
- Task "Markdown rendering" (58300471) — status: done, priority: high, linked to agent 3613bf98
- Task "kanban for tasks" (f4687690) — status: in-progress, priority: medium, linked to agent 2ba0e3b0

### 3. Task Store (`server/task-store.ts`)

File-based JSON persistence layer:

**Storage Location:** `.thos/tasks/tasks.json` (relative to project root)

**Methods:**
- `loadAll()` — Returns array of Task objects from disk (or empty array if file missing)
- `save(tasks)` — Debounced write (150ms delay) for streaming events
- `saveSync(tasks)` — Immediate synchronous write for critical changes
- `flush(tasks)` — Final write during graceful shutdown (clears debounce timer)

**Behavior:**
- Uses same debounced/sync pattern as SessionStore
- Creates `.thos/tasks/` directory automatically (recursive)
- Handles errors gracefully (logs to console, returns defaults)

### 4. TaskPanel Component (`components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx`)

Right-side panel for task management:

**Structure:**
- **Header** — "Tasks" label with New (+) button and close button
- **Task groups** — Organized by status:
  - "In Progress" (expanded by default)
  - "Todo" (expanded by default)
  - "Done" (collapsible, collapsed by default)
- **Create form** — Shows when + button clicked

**GroupingLogic (lines 33-38):**
```typescript
const grouped = useMemo(() => {
  const inProgress = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "in-progress");
  const todo = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "todo");
  const done = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "done");
  return { inProgress, todo, done };
}, [tasks]);
```

**Features:**
- Task count badges on group headers
- Click to create new task
- Pass callbacks to TaskCard for update/delete/delegate operations

### 5. TaskCreateForm Component (`components/dashboard/task-create-form.tsx`)

Form for creating new tasks:

**Fields:**
- Title (text input, required)
- Description (textarea, optional)
- Priority dropdown (default: "medium")

**Actions:**
- Submit button (disabled if title empty)
- Form resets after creation

### 6. WebSocket Hook (`hooks/use-websocket.ts`)

Task state management in React:

**Task State (lines 300-301):**
```typescript
const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);
```

**Task Handlers (lines 372-391):**
- **task_list** (on browser connect) — Replace all tasks with server state
- **task_updated** — Map replacement: update task by ID
- **task_deleted** — Filter removal: delete task by ID

**Action Functions (lines 748-775):**
- `createTask(title, description, priority)` — Sends `create_task` message
- `updateTask(taskId, updates)` — Sends `update_task` message with partial updates
- `deleteTask(taskId)` — Sends `delete_task` message
- `delegateTask(taskId)` — Sends `delegate_task` message

**Return Value (line 812):**
Hook exports `tasks`, `createTask`, `updateTask`, `deleteTask`, `delegateTask`

### 7. Dashboard Page Integration (`app/dashboard/page.tsx`)

Task system wired into main layout:

**State Management (lines 50-54):**
```typescript
tasks,
createTask,
updateTask,
deleteTask,
delegateTask,
```

**UI Layout (lines 113-144):**
- Tasks hidden by default (`showTasks` state)
- Right-side drawer on desktop (fixed width w-80, scrollable)
- Mobile drawer with backdrop overlay
- TaskPanel receives all tasks and callbacks
- Clicking "view agent" in task card selects agent and closes panel

### 8. WebSocket Server Handlers (`server/ws.ts`)

Backend task operations:

**Restore (lines 248-257):**
```typescript
function restoreTasks() {
  const persisted = taskStore.loadAll();
  for (const t of persisted) {
    tasks.set(t.id, t);
  }
}
```

**Broadcast (lines 259-272):**
```typescript
function buildTaskList(): Task[] {
  return Array.from(tasks.values()).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
}
function broadcastTaskList() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ type: "task_list", tasks: buildTaskList() });
  for (const ws of browserSockets) {
    if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(payload);
  }
}
```

**Create (lines 693-708):**
- Generate 4-byte hex ID
- Set initial status to "todo", agentId to null
- Set timestamps
- Persist and broadcast

**Update (lines 711-726):**
- Merge updates into existing task
- Update timestamp
- **Special logic**: If task marked as done AND has agentId, stop the linked agent (lines 719-723)
- Persist and broadcast

**Delete (lines 728-732):**
- Remove from Map
- Persist to disk
- Broadcast updated list

**Delegate (lines 735-746):**
- Spawn new Claude agent with task title/description as prompt
- Link task to new agentId
- Mark task as "in-progress"
- Persist and broadcast

### 9. Data Flow Summary

**On Browser Connect:**
1. Server sends `agent_list` (sidebar)
2. Server sends `task_list` (all tasks, sorted newest first)
3. Hook receives and sets `tasks` state

**Creating a Task:**
1. User fills form and clicks Create
2. Browser sends `create_task` message
3. Server generates ID, creates Task object, persists to disk
4. Server broadcasts `task_list` to all browsers
5. Hook receives update and refreshes `tasks` state
6. TaskPanel re-renders with new task

**Updating a Task (e.g., changing status):**
1. User clicks status badge or edit button
2. Hook sends `update_task` message
3. Server updates Task, calls `stopAgent()` if marked done with agentId
4. Server broadcasts `task_list` to all browsers
5. Hook receives and updates local state

**Delegating a Task:**
1. User clicks play icon on task card
2. Hook sends `delegate_task` message
3. Server calls `spawnClaude()` with task title+description as prompt
4. Server links task.agentId to new agent ID
5. Server marks task as "in-progress"
6. Server broadcasts `task_list` and new agent appears in sidebar

### 10. Key Design Patterns

1. **Unidirectional data flow** — Browser hook → send message → server → broadcast to all browsers → update state
2. **Debounced persistence** — Streaming updates use 150ms debounce, critical changes are sync
3. **Newest-first sorting** — Tasks sorted by createdAt descending
4. **Optional agent linking** — Tasks can exist without agents; agents archived when task marked done
5. **Message deduplication** — Uses task ID as stable key (4-byte hex)
6. **Mobile responsive** — Drawer-based UI with backdrop on mobile, fixed panel on desktop

This architecture provides a clean separation between UI, state management, persistence, and WebSocket relay, making the task system modular and maintainable.

## Current State

The task system has:
- **Data model** (`lib/types.ts`): `Task` with `id`, `title`, `description`, `status` (todo | in-progress | done), `priority` (low | medium | high | urgent), `agentId`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
- **TaskPanel** (`components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx`): Right-side panel (w-80) showing tasks grouped by status (In Progress, Todo, Done) as vertical lists. Groups are rendered with a `TaskGroup` component. Done section is collapsible.

## Requirements

Transform the task panel from a vertical grouped list into a proper kanban board with:
1. Three columns: Todo, In Progress, Done
2. Drag and drop to move tasks between columns (status changes)
3. Cards within columns should be compact but show key info
4. The kanban should replace the current task panel but needs more space

# Kanban Board for Tasks

## Context

The current task panel is a narrow right-side drawer (w-80) showing tasks in grouped vertical lists. A kanban board with draggable columns provides a much better visual workflow — seeing todo, in-progress, and done at a glance with drag-and-drop to change status.

## Approach

**Layout**: When `showTasks` is toggled, the kanban board replaces the chat area (flex-1) instead of appearing as a narrow side panel. The sidebar stays visible. This gives the board full width for 3 columns.

**Drag & Drop**: Native HTML5 drag-and-drop (no library). The interaction is simple — cards move between 3 columns. The existing status toggle on each card remains as a fallback (especially for mobile/touch where native DnD doesn't work).

**Reuse**: `TaskCard` and `TaskCreateForm` are reused unchanged. `TaskCard` gets wrapped in a thin `DraggableTaskCard` div that adds `draggable` + drag event handlers. No changes to the WebSocket hook, server, or types.

## Files

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `components/dashboard/kanban-board.tsx` | **Create** — kanban board with 3 columns, drag/drop, create form |
| `app/dashboard/page.tsx` | **Modify** — swap `{showTasks ? <KanbanBoard> : <Chat>}` |
| `components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx` | **Delete** — replaced by kanban board |

# Changelog

## 2026-02-17 — Connection status toast

WebSocket reconnection happened silently. Added brief toast notifications when the connection drops ("Connection lost") and restores ("Reconnected") to build trust that the system is recovering. Toasts do not fire on the initial page load.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `sonner` for toast notifications.

- **`components/ui/sonner.tsx`** — New Toaster wrapper component with dark theme and monospace font.

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Added `useEffect` watching `connected` state with a `hasConnectedRef` guard to skip the initial connection. Shows `toast.error` on disconnect and `toast.success` on reconnect. Renders `<Toaster />` in the page.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix duplicate "Session started" on follow-up messages

Sending a follow-up message to a running agent would re-display "Session started — model: ..., cwd: ..." in the chat. The CLI re-sends `system/init` on every turn, and the server was relaying and storing all of them.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Only relay the first `system/init` message per agent. Subsequent init messages (re-sent by CLI on each turn) are still used to update `sessionId` and status, but are no longer recorded in history or broadcast to browsers.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Changed `system/init` ChatMessage ID from `nextId()` (random) to `dedup-init-{session_id}` (stable) as a belt-and-suspenders safeguard.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix message duplication in chat

Claude CLI sends cumulative NDJSON snapshots for assistant messages (each line is a complete snapshot of the message so far). The server correctly deduplicates these in stored history, but the browser received every snapshot as a live relay and appended each one as a new ChatMessage, causing messages to appear 2-4x in the chat window. Also caused React duplicate key warnings.

### Changes

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Added `getRelayDedupKey()` to extract stable message IDs from relay messages (assistant `message.id`, user `uuid`). Changed `relayChatMessage()` to use these stable IDs (prefixed with `dedup-`) instead of generating new random IDs for each snapshot. Updated the relay handler to replace existing ChatMessages with the same dedup ID instead of appending. Added `findLastRawIndex()` helper to also deduplicate raw messages in the debug view.

## 2026-02-17 — Message timestamps

Messages had no timestamps, making it hard to track conversation flow. Added relative timestamps ("just now", "2m ago", "1h ago") below each user and assistant message bubble, with absolute time shown on hover via the native tooltip.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added `formatRelativeTime()` utility and `RelativeTime` component that auto-updates every 30s. Renders below each user/assistant bubble as a small muted label. Uses `<time>` element with `title` for hover-to-see-absolute-time and `dateTime` for accessibility.

## 2026-02-17 — Agent cost/duration summary

Added a compact summary bar at the top of the chat area showing total cost, duration, turn count, and token usage for the active agent. Stats are extracted from `result` messages in the raw NDJSON stream.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/agent-summary.tsx`** — New component that scans raw Claude messages for `result` entries and displays total cost (last result's cumulative `total_cost_usd`), total duration (summed `duration_ms`), total turns (summed `num_turns`), and total token usage (summed from each result's `usage` object) in a slim bar with icons. Hovering the token count shows a breakdown of input, output, cache read, and cache write tokens. Only renders when result data is available.

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Added `AgentSummary` between the status bar and the scrollable message area.

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `total_cost_usd` field to `ClaudeResult` (the actual field name used by the CLI, alongside the existing `cost_usd`).

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Updated result summary text to prefer `total_cost_usd` over `cost_usd`.

## 2026-02-17 — Empty state for chat area

When no agent is selected, the chat area showed only a single line of text. Replaced it with a proper empty state featuring a terminal icon, descriptive copy, and quick-reference cards for Chat and Tasks features.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Replaced the minimal "Type a prompt to spawn a Claude agent" text with a centered empty state panel showing a terminal icon, heading, description, and two feature hint cards (Chat, Tasks). Added `Terminal`, `MessageSquare`, and `ListTodo` icon imports from lucide-react.

## 2026-02-17 — Copy message button

No way to copy a message's content. A small copy icon on hover makes it easy.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added a `CopyButton` component that appears in the top-right corner of user and assistant message bubbles on hover. Uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and shows a checkmark for 1.5s after copying. The message bubble gets `group relative` classes to support the hover reveal.

## 2026-02-17 — Archive agent when task marked as complete

When a task with a linked agent was marked as "done", the agent kept running. Now the server automatically stops (archives) the linked agent when the task status is set to "done".

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — In the `update_task` handler, after persisting and broadcasting the task update, check if the task was marked "done" and has a linked `agentId`. If so, call `stopAgent()` to kill the tmux session and set the agent to "done" status.

## 2026-02-17 — Edit todo functionality

Task editing was only accessible via a hidden double-click gesture on the title, making it hard to discover.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`** — Added explicit edit button (pencil icon) to the task card hover actions, visible alongside delegate and delete buttons. Edit mode now includes an inline priority selector so all task fields (title, description, priority) can be edited in one pass. Double-click on title still works as a shortcut. All edit state (title, description, priority) is properly initialized when entering edit mode from either entry point.

## 2026-02-17 — Improved tool approval window

The tool approval card was too small (`max-w-lg`) and showed raw JSON, making it hard to review tool inputs before approving.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/control-request.tsx`** — Redesigned the tool approval card:
  - Wider layout (`max-w-2xl`) with solid border instead of dashed
  - Header row with shield icon, formatted tool name, and full name for namespaced tools
  - Individual input parameters displayed as labeled fields instead of raw JSON dump
  - Long string values (commands, file contents) render in scrollable code blocks
  - Short strings render as inline `<code>` elements
  - Allow/Deny buttons now have icons (Check/X) and Deny uses `outline` variant instead of `destructive`
  - Resolved state shows a colored pill badge ("Allowed" / "Denied") instead of generic "Resolved" text
  - Dimmed styling when resolved to reduce visual noise
  - Shows `description` field from the protocol when available

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added optional `description` field to `ChatMessage.controlRequest` type.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Pass through `description` from `ClaudeControlRequest` to the `ChatMessage` control request payload.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix initial message missing from chat history

When spawning a new agent, the initial user prompt was sent to the CLI but never recorded in `messageHistory` or relayed to the browser. This meant the first message never appeared in the chat view, and was also missing after page reloads.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Added `recordAndSend()` calls in both prompt delivery paths (direct CLI connect and `hook_response` fallback) so the initial user message is stored in history and broadcast to browsers, matching the behavior of follow-up `send_message` handling.

## 2026-02-16 — Markdown rendering

**Task:** [#58300471] Markdown rendering

Assistant messages were rendered as plain text, so markdown output from Claude (code blocks, headers, lists, bold, tables) showed as raw syntax.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `react-markdown` (v10.1.0) and `remark-gfm` (v4.0.1) for markdown parsing with GitHub Flavored Markdown support (tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolinks).

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Assistant messages now render through `<Markdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>` instead of plain text. User messages remain plain text with `whitespace-pre-wrap`. System messages unchanged.

- **`app/globals.css`** — Added `.prose-msg` class with styles for all markdown elements:
  - Headings (h1–h4), bold/strong
  - Inline code (subtle background) and fenced code blocks (darker background, horizontal scroll)
  - Ordered and unordered lists with nested list support
  - Blockquotes (left border accent, muted color)
  - Links (primary color, underlined)
  - Tables (collapsed borders, header background)
  - Horizontal rules, images
  - Light theme overrides for backgrounds and borders

# Changelog

## 2026-02-17 — Kanban board for tasks

Replaced the narrow right-side task panel drawer with a full-width kanban board. When toggled, the kanban replaces the chat area with three columns (Todo, In Progress, Done) for a proper visual workflow.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/kanban-board.tsx`** — New kanban board component with three status columns. Cards can be dragged between columns using native HTML5 drag-and-drop to change task status. Columns highlight on drag-over. Reuses existing `TaskCard` and `TaskCreateForm` components. Responsive layout: stacks vertically on mobile, three-column grid on desktop.

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Swapped the layout so `showTasks` replaces the chat area with `KanbanBoard` instead of opening a side drawer. Removed task panel backdrop and drawer markup.

- **`components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx`** — Deleted. Fully replaced by kanban board.

## 2026-02-17 — Connection status toast

WebSocket reconnection happened silently. Added brief toast notifications when the connection drops ("Connection lost") and restores ("Reconnected") to build trust that the system is recovering. Toasts do not fire on the initial page load.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `sonner` for toast notifications.

- **`components/ui/sonner.tsx`** — New Toaster wrapper component with dark theme and monospace font.

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Added `useEffect` watching `connected` state with a `hasConnectedRef` guard to skip the initial connection. Shows `toast.error` on disconnect and `toast.success` on reconnect. Renders `<Toaster />` in the page.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix duplicate "Session started" on follow-up messages

Sending a follow-up message to a running agent would re-display "Session started — model: ..., cwd: ..." in the chat. The CLI re-sends `system/init` on every turn, and the server was relaying and storing all of them.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Only relay the first `system/init` message per agent. Subsequent init messages (re-sent by CLI on each turn) are still used to update `sessionId` and status, but are no longer recorded in history or broadcast to browsers.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Changed `system/init` ChatMessage ID from `nextId()` (random) to `dedup-init-{session_id}` (stable) as a belt-and-suspenders safeguard.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix message duplication in chat

Claude CLI sends cumulative NDJSON snapshots for assistant messages (each line is a complete snapshot of the message so far). The server correctly deduplicates these in stored history, but the browser received every snapshot as a live relay and appended each one as a new ChatMessage, causing messages to appear 2-4x in the chat window. Also caused React duplicate key warnings.

### Changes

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Added `getRelayDedupKey()` to extract stable message IDs from relay messages (assistant `message.id`, user `uuid`). Changed `relayChatMessage()` to use these stable IDs (prefixed with `dedup-`) instead of generating new random IDs for each snapshot. Updated the relay handler to replace existing ChatMessages with the same dedup ID instead of appending. Added `findLastRawIndex()` helper to also deduplicate raw messages in the debug view.

## 2026-02-17 — Message timestamps

Messages had no timestamps, making it hard to track conversation flow. Added relative timestamps ("just now", "2m ago", "1h ago") below each user and assistant message bubble, with absolute time shown on hover via the native tooltip.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added `formatRelativeTime()` utility and `RelativeTime` component that auto-updates every 30s. Renders below each user/assistant bubble as a small muted label. Uses `<time>` element with `title` for hover-to-see-absolute-time and `dateTime` for accessibility.

## 2026-02-17 — Agent cost/duration summary

Added a compact summary bar at the top of the chat area showing total cost, duration, turn count, and token usage for the active agent. Stats are extracted from `result` messages in the raw NDJSON stream.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/agent-summary.tsx`** — New component that scans raw Claude messages for `result` entries and displays total cost (last result's cumulative `total_cost_usd`), total duration (summed `duration_ms`), total turns (summed `num_turns`), and total token usage (summed from each result's `usage` object) in a slim bar with icons. Hovering the token count shows a breakdown of input, output, cache read, and cache write tokens. Only renders when result data is available.

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Added `AgentSummary` between the status bar and the scrollable message area.

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `total_cost_usd` field to `ClaudeResult` (the actual field name used by the CLI, alongside the existing `cost_usd`).

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Updated result summary text to prefer `total_cost_usd` over `cost_usd`.

## 2026-02-17 — Empty state for chat area

When no agent is selected, the chat area showed only a single line of text. Replaced it with a proper empty state featuring a terminal icon, descriptive copy, and quick-reference cards for Chat and Tasks features.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Replaced the minimal "Type a prompt to spawn a Claude agent" text with a centered empty state panel showing a terminal icon, heading, description, and two feature hint cards (Chat, Tasks). Added `Terminal`, `MessageSquare`, and `ListTodo` icon imports from lucide-react.

## 2026-02-17 — Copy message button

No way to copy a message's content. A small copy icon on hover makes it easy.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added a `CopyButton` component that appears in the top-right corner of user and assistant message bubbles on hover. Uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and shows a checkmark for 1.5s after copying. The message bubble gets `group relative` classes to support the hover reveal.

## 2026-02-17 — Archive agent when task marked as complete

When a task with a linked agent was marked as "done", the agent kept running. Now the server automatically stops (archives) the linked agent when the task status is set to "done".

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — In the `update_task` handler, after persisting and broadcasting the task update, check if the task was marked "done" and has a linked `agentId`. If so, call `stopAgent()` to kill the tmux session and set the agent to "done" status.

## 2026-02-17 — Edit todo functionality

Task editing was only accessible via a hidden double-click gesture on the title, making it hard to discover.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`** — Added explicit edit button (pencil icon) to the task card hover actions, visible alongside delegate and delete buttons. Edit mode now includes an inline priority selector so all task fields (title, description, priority) can be edited in one pass. Double-click on title still works as a shortcut. All edit state (title, description, priority) is properly initialized when entering edit mode from either entry point.

## 2026-02-17 — Improved tool approval window

The tool approval card was too small (`max-w-lg`) and showed raw JSON, making it hard to review tool inputs before approving.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/control-request.tsx`** — Redesigned the tool approval card:
  - Wider layout (`max-w-2xl`) with solid border instead of dashed
  - Header row with shield icon, formatted tool name, and full name for namespaced tools

## 2026-02-17 — Connection status toast

WebSocket reconnection happened silently. Added brief toast notifications when the connection drops ("Connection lost") and restores ("Reconnected") to build trust that the system is recovering. Toasts do not fire on the initial page load.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `sonner` for toast notifications.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix duplicate "Session started" on follow-up messages

Sending a follow-up message to a running agent would re-display "Session started — model: ..., cwd: ..." in the chat. The CLI re-sends `system/init` on every turn, and the server was relaying and storing all of them.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Only relay the first `system/init` message per agent. Subsequent init messages (re-sent by CLI on each turn) are still used to update `sessionId` and status, but are no longer recorded in history or broadcast to browsers.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Changed `system/init` ChatMessage ID from `nextId()` (random) to `dedup-init-{session_id}` (stable) as a belt-and-suspenders safeguard.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix message duplication in chat

Claude CLI sends cumulative NDJSON snapshots for assistant messages (each line is a complete snapshot of the message so far). The server correctly deduplicates these in stored history, but the browser received every snapshot as a live relay and appended each one as a new ChatMessage, causing messages to appear 2-4x in the chat window. Also caused React duplicate key warnings.

### Changes

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Added `getRelayDedupKey()` to extract stable message IDs from relay messages (assistant `message.id`, user `uuid`). Updated the relay handler to replace existing ChatMessages with the same dedup ID instead of appending. Added `findLastRawIndex()` helper to also deduplicate raw messages in the debug view.

## 2026-02-17 — Message timestamps

Messages had no timestamps, making it hard to track conversation flow. Added relative timestamps ("just now", "2m ago", "1h ago") below each user and assistant message bubble, with absolute time shown on hover via the native tooltip.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added `formatRelativeTime()` utility and `RelativeTime` component that auto-updates every 30s. Renders below each user/assistant bubble as a small muted label. Uses `<time>` element with `title` for hover-to-see-absolute-time and `dateTime` for accessibility.

## 2026-02-17 — Agent cost/duration summary

Added a compact summary bar at the top of the chat area showing total cost, duration, turn count, and token usage for the active agent. Stats are extracted from `result` messages in the raw NDJSON stream.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/agent-summary.tsx`** — New component that scans raw Claude messages for `result` entries and displays total cost (last result's cumulative `total_cost_usd`), total duration (summed `duration_ms`), total turns (summed `num_turns`), and total token usage (summed from each result's `usage` object) in a slim bar with icons. - **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Added `AgentSummary` between the status bar and the scrollable message area.

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `total_cost_usd` field to `ClaudeResult` (the actual field name used by the CLI, alongside the existing `cost_usd`).

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Updated result summary text to prefer `total_cost_usd` over `cost_usd`.

When no agent is selected, the chat area showed only a single line of text. Replaced it with a proper empty state featuring a terminal icon, descriptive copy, and quick-reference cards for Chat and Tasks features.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Replaced the minimal "Type a prompt to spawn a Claude agent" text with a centered empty state panel showing a terminal icon, heading, description, and two feature hint cards (Chat, Tasks). No way to copy a message's content. A small copy icon on hover makes it easy.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added a `CopyButton` component that appears in the top-right corner of user and assistant message bubbles on hover. When a task with a linked agent was marked as "done", the agent kept running. Now the server automatically stops (archives) the linked agent when the task status is set to "done".

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — In the `update_task` handler, after persisting and broadcasting the task update, check if the task was marked "done" and has a linked `agentId`. If so, call `stopAgent()` to kill the tmux session and set the agent to "done" status.

# Changelog

## 2026-02-17 — Kanban board for tasks

Replaced the narrow right-side task panel drawer with a kanban board that slides in above the chat. The board takes 45% of the vertical space with four columns (Icebox, Todo, In Progress, Done), and the chat remains visible below. Cards can be dragged between columns to change status.

### Changes

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `"icebox"` to `TaskStatus` union for parking ideas/later items.

- **`components/dashboard/kanban-board.tsx`** — New kanban board component with four status columns. Cards can be dragged between columns using native HTML5 drag-and-drop to change task status. Columns highlight on drag-over. Reuses existing `TaskCard` and `TaskCreateForm` components. Horizontally scrollable with `min-w-[240px]` per column.

- **`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`** — Added icebox to status color map (purple), label map, and status cycling (icebox → todo).

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Kanban board appears above the chat (45% height) when toggled, with chat taking the remaining space below. Sidebar stays visible alongside both.

- **`components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx`** — Deleted. Fully replaced by kanban board.

# Changelog

## 2026-02-17 — Kanban board for tasks

Replaced the narrow right-side task panel drawer with a kanban board that slides in above the chat. The board takes 45% of the vertical space with four columns (Icebox, Todo, In Progress, Done), and the chat remains visible below. Cards can be dragged between columns to change status.

### Changes

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `"icebox"` to `TaskStatus` union for parking ideas/later items.

- **`components/dashboard/kanban-board.tsx`** — New kanban board component with four status columns. Cards can be dragged between columns using native HTML5 drag-and-drop to change task status. Columns highlight on drag-over. Reuses existing `TaskCard` and `TaskCreateForm` components. Horizontally scrollable with `min-w-[240px]` per column.

- **`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`** — Added icebox to status color map (purple), label map, and status cycling (icebox → todo).

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Kanban board appears above the chat (45% height) when toggled, with chat taking the remaining space below. Sidebar stays visible alongside both.

- **`components/dashboard/task-panel.tsx`** — Deleted. Fully replaced by kanban board.

## 2026-02-17 — Connection status toast

WebSocket reconnection happened silently. Added brief toast notifications when the connection drops ("Connection lost") and restores ("Reconnected") to build trust that the system is recovering. Toasts do not fire on the initial page load.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `sonner` for toast notifications.

- **`components/ui/sonner.tsx`** — New Toaster wrapper component with dark theme and monospace font.

- **`app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — Added `useEffect` watching `connected` state with a `hasConnectedRef` guard to skip the initial connection. Shows `toast.error` on disconnect and `toast.success` on reconnect. Renders `<Toaster />` in the page.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix duplicate "Session started" on follow-up messages

Sending a follow-up message to a running agent would re-display "Session started — model: ..., cwd: ..." in the chat. The CLI re-sends `system/init` on every turn, and the server was relaying and storing all of them.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Only relay the first `system/init` message per agent. Subsequent init messages (re-sent by CLI on each turn) are still used to update `sessionId` and status, but are no longer recorded in history or broadcast to browsers.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Changed `system/init` ChatMessage ID from `nextId()` (random) to `dedup-init-{session_id}` (stable) as a belt-and-suspenders safeguard.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix message duplication in chat

Claude CLI sends cumulative NDJSON snapshots for assistant messages (each line is a complete snapshot of the message so far). The server correctly deduplicates these in stored history, but the browser received every snapshot as a live relay and appended each one as a new ChatMessage, causing messages to appear 2-4x in the chat window. Also caused React duplicate key warnings.

### Changes

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Added `getRelayDedupKey()` to extract stable message IDs from relay messages (assistant `message.id`, user `uuid`). Changed `relayChatMessage()` to use these stable IDs (prefixed with `dedup-`) instead of generating new random IDs for each snapshot. Updated the relay handler to replace existing ChatMessages with the same dedup ID instead of appending. Added `findLastRawIndex()` helper to also deduplicate raw messages in the debug view.

## 2026-02-17 — Message timestamps

Messages had no timestamps, making it hard to track conversation flow. Added relative timestamps ("just now", "2m ago", "1h ago") below each user and assistant message bubble, with absolute time shown on hover via the native tooltip.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added `formatRelativeTime()` utility and `RelativeTime` component that auto-updates every 30s. Renders below each user/assistant bubble as a small muted label. Uses `<time>` element with `title` for hover-to-see-absolute-time and `dateTime` for accessibility.

## 2026-02-17 — Agent cost/duration summary

Added a compact summary bar at the top of the chat area showing total cost, duration, turn count, and token usage for the active agent. Stats are extracted from `result` messages in the raw NDJSON stream.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/agent-summary.tsx`** — New component that scans raw Claude messages for `result` entries and displays total cost (last result's cumulative `total_cost_usd`), total duration (summed `duration_ms`), total turns (summed `num_turns`), and total token usage (summed from each result's `usage` object) in a slim bar with icons. Hovering the token count shows a breakdown of input, output, cache read, and cache write tokens. Only renders when result data is available.

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Added `AgentSummary` between the status bar and the scrollable message area.

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added `total_cost_usd` field to `ClaudeResult` (the actual field name used by the CLI, alongside the existing `cost_usd`).

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Updated result summary text to prefer `total_cost_usd` over `cost_usd`.

## 2026-02-17 — Empty state for chat area

When no agent is selected, the chat area showed only a single line of text. Replaced it with a proper empty state featuring a terminal icon, descriptive copy, and quick-reference cards for Chat and Tasks features.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/chat.tsx`** — Replaced the minimal "Type a prompt to spawn a Claude agent" text with a centered empty state panel showing a terminal icon, heading, description, and two feature hint cards (Chat, Tasks). Added `Terminal`, `MessageSquare`, and `ListTodo` icon imports from lucide-react.

## 2026-02-17 — Copy message button

No way to copy a message's content. A small copy icon on hover makes it easy.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Added a `CopyButton` component that appears in the top-right corner of user and assistant message bubbles on hover. Uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and shows a checkmark for 1.5s after copying. The message bubble gets `group relative` classes to support the hover reveal.

## 2026-02-17 — Archive agent when task marked as complete

When a task with a linked agent was marked as "done", the agent kept running. Now the server automatically stops (archives) the linked agent when the task status is set to "done".

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — In the `update_task` handler, after persisting and broadcasting the task update, check if the task was marked "done" and has a linked `agentId`. If so, call `stopAgent()` to kill the tmux session and set the agent to "done" status.

## 2026-02-17 — Edit todo functionality

Task editing was only accessible via a hidden double-click gesture on the title, making it hard to discover.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/task-card.tsx`** — Added explicit edit button (pencil icon) to the task card hover actions, visible alongside delegate and delete buttons. Edit mode now includes an inline priority selector so all task fields (title, description, priority) can be edited in one pass. Double-click on title still works as a shortcut. All edit state (title, description, priority) is properly initialized when entering edit mode from either entry point.

## 2026-02-17 — Improved tool approval window

The tool approval card was too small (`max-w-lg`) and showed raw JSON, making it hard to review tool inputs before approving.

### Changes

- **`components/dashboard/control-request.tsx`** — Redesigned the tool approval card:
  - Wider layout (`max-w-2xl`) with solid border instead of dashed
  - Header row with shield icon, formatted tool name, and full name for namespaced tools
  - Individual input parameters displayed as labeled fields instead of raw JSON dump
  - Long string values (commands, file contents) render in scrollable code blocks
  - Short strings render as inline `<code>` elements
  - Allow/Deny buttons now have icons (Check/X) and Deny uses `outline` variant instead of `destructive`
  - Resolved state shows a colored pill badge ("Allowed" / "Denied") instead of generic "Resolved" text
  - Dimmed styling when resolved to reduce visual noise
  - Shows `description` field from the protocol when available

- **`lib/types.ts`** — Added optional `description` field to `ChatMessage.controlRequest` type.

- **`hooks/use-websocket.ts`** — Pass through `description` from `ClaudeControlRequest` to the `ChatMessage` control request payload.

## 2026-02-17 — Fix initial message missing from chat history

When spawning a new agent, the initial user prompt was sent to the CLI but never recorded in `messageHistory` or relayed to the browser. This meant the first message never appeared in the chat view, and was also missing after page reloads.

### Changes

- **`server/ws.ts`** — Added `recordAndSend()` calls in both prompt delivery paths (direct CLI connect and `hook_response` fallback) so the initial user message is stored in history and broadcast to browsers, matching the behavior of follow-up `send_message` handling.

## 2026-02-16 — Markdown rendering

**Task:** [#58300471] Markdown rendering

Assistant messages were rendered as plain text, so markdown output from Claude (code blocks, headers, lists, bold, tables) showed as raw syntax.

### Changes

- **`package.json`** — Added `react-markdown` (v10.1.0) and `remark-gfm` (v4.0.1) for markdown parsing with GitHub Flavored Markdown support (tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolinks).

- **`components/dashboard/message.tsx`** — Assistant messages now render through `<Markdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>` instead of plain text. User messages remain plain text with `whitespace-pre-wrap`. System messages unchanged.

- **`app/globals.css`** — Added `.prose-msg` class with styles for all markdown elements:
  - Headings (h1–h4), bold/strong
  - Inline code (subtle background) and fenced code blocks (darker background, horizontal scroll)
  - Ordered and unordered lists with nested list support
  - Blockquotes (left border accent, muted color)
  - Links (primary color, underlined)
  - Tables (collapsed borders, header background)
  - Horizontal rules, images
  - Light theme overrides for backgrounds and borders
